lines.en: And on that note, we return to the tragic tale of Maya Makinami (or the one who wears her skin).
Hurt and betrayed by the one she loves the most, the skinwalker skin-walked herself all the way over to the place she loves the most.
It was a random vending machine somewhere near the halfway point between the home she had and the home she wanted. But that’s not where she is right now. Right now, she’s at the shrine.
And she doesn’t care much for that place. She doesn’t care much for gods or sweeping. Even the miko dress she normally wore here pissed her off on days when it didn’t agree with the heat.
But that was fine, because there was normally someone more than willing to help her take it off. Right now, though, he could be taking off some idol’s Kagome costume and she wouldn’t even know it!
Her blood boiled! Her hands shook! How could such a terrible thing happen to her?! But if only she knew the horrors she had already seen — and the others that have yet to befall her.
Into the frame walks her best friend!
She’s a magical girl who goes by the name Ami Arakawa during the day and Sakura Sunlight at night! Her secret power was always being seven and a half steps ahead.
But her other secret power was cum absorption! She was almost 50%% cum now! Good job, Sakura Sunlight!
But her other secret power was cum absorption! Just no one knew about that yet since there was no cum for her to absorb!
Regardless, she was here now! And she wasn’t about to let her best friend feel lonely anymore.
: Maya? Are you anywhere around here? Can you hear me?
She could! But her lips remained shut while she pictured those of a pink-haired girl slowly opening and welcoming a dick into her mouth. How lewd, this imaginary cuckoldry! Bad Maya!
: I sure hope she’s okay...she seemed really upset back there. But at least I get where she’s coming from.
The hero spoke to herself. She did that a lot when she wasn’t speaking to others. Or things that she thought were there but weren’t actually there even though they were still kind of there.
Right now, Maya Makinami actually was there, though. And sensing that Ami was just seven and a half steps away from kicking dirt into her shoes, she finally decided to speak up.
: How did you know I was here?...
: Oh! There you are. I’ve been looking all over for- are you crying?
: It’s...allergy season.
: You can tell me if you are, Maya. It’s okay to cry. It’s not like I’m going to tell anyone.
Ami Arakawa was so nice! Only a good person would say good things to a bad person. And that’s what’s happening right now! It’s a remarkable show of kindness. She’s so great!
: Why...aren’t you at the party?
: You think I was just going to let you dramatically storm off like that without chasing after you? The party can wait. Your feelings can not.
So kind!
: Feelings are stupid. I just thought it would be more fun to spend Halloween on my own this year. That’s all.
So mean, rejecting Ami’s kindness like that! And such a liar too!
: And how exactly were you going to have fun at the shrine? You hate this place.
That’s a fact Ami Arakawa remembers because she’s a good friend who always pays attention to what the people she loves say or do.
: I just...left something here. That’s all.
: Well, I hope it was your honesty since you’re being a big ole liar-pants right now.

Fact 1: honesty is not tangible. Fact 2: Ami Arakawa knew Maya would never find hers even if it was. Fact 3: Ami looks super cute in her costume this year! Her thighs look so soft! I bet she moisturizes!
: Just leave me alone, please...I’m really not in the mood today.
: I can’t just leave you alone, Maya. Not when you’re like this. What kind of friend would that make me?
: How about...we spend Halloween together this year? Just you and me. Nobody else really wants me at the party anyway. And the people who do probably just want to beat me up.
: No one wants to beat you up. They all just think you’re batshit insane. Hitting people like that is normally frowned upon.
: Well, at least it’s nice to know that being looked down on can have perks from time to time. But what do you say, Maya? Are you really gonna keep rejecting me? Or can we have some fun together?
: Ami...did you come after me on your own? Or did...somebody put you up to this?
: Hm? That’s a weird question to ask your best friend. Why would anyone send me after you? I love you more than anybody in the world.
: Anybody more than Sensei, you mean.
: He doesn’t count.
: Then...Niki?
: You would still choose me over her, right? Just because she’s moving in doesn’t mean you don’t need me anymore, does it? Otherwise, you wouldn’t be here. Right?
: Maya...
: I think we should sit down and take a break for a little while, okay?
So sit they did but break they didn’t! At least not in a bad way. Because breaking can be good sometimes! This doesn’t have to be a sad day!
Relax and breathe and celebrate! Friendship makes the dream work. Then team work makes the other thing and...something makes the...cream...jerk.
It’s rhyming time! It’s time to rhyme! It’s time to build a fifth ark! The third is full of bullet holes, the fourth is made of pine bark!
So anyway, just look at this. Lock eyes with screen, put dick in fist. Then squeeze until it’s purple while you wait for them to kiss!

Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami. Ami Ami, Ami Ami, Ami Ami Ami?
The needle goes in to suck out the truth.
: You’ve always had pretty harsh feelings when it comes to Niki, haven’t you?
: I don’t know what you’re talking about.
: Oh, come on. I know your feelings toward her and Noriko aren’t just because of a distaste for pink. You don’t like them because of how important they are to Sensei.
: It’s the same reason you stormed out today. But that’s nothing to be embarrassed about, Maya. I get it. And honestly, it makes me feel a little weird too.
: You just gonna stay silent until I change topics? Is that what we’re doing?
: I cracked and made how I really feel way too obvious today. I realize there’s no getting out of it now. But...
: What really confuses me is why you’re treating me like nothing happened instead of ripping my guts out since this is obviously more than a stupid crush.
: If I wanted to rip your guts out, I would have done it one of the other millions of times you’ve lied right to my face.
: Do you really think I’m that gullible? That I wouldn’t catch on to my best friend in the whole wide world fucking my uncle while I’m home sometimes? Do you really think I’m that dumb?
: I...am suddenly having second thoughts about the position I chose to have this conversation in.
: Pfft!
: Or...not?
: Why did you lie to me, Maya? Why don’t you ever tell the truth?
: What do you mean “why did I lie?” My entire relationship with him was supposed to be confidential. And you were the last person who was ever supposed to know about it.
: Because I love him more?
: Because you’re a fucking psychopath who would cut his dick off if it was the only way you knew how to keep him close to you.
: There are other ways to keep him close. And I would never intentionally hurt Sensei like that. He isn’t Sensei without his dick and I think it should stay attached.
: Whatever...it’s not like it even matters anymore now that Niki’s come back into the picture. We’re both fucked. Like, what does either one of us have that she doesn’t?
: We’re...closer to Sensei’s preferred age group?
: Yippee.
: Are you giving up then?
: I don’t want to...but it feels like he’s been trying to get me to for months now.
: Is that so?
: All I’ve done lately is chase after him. And it’s made me stop and think about how all of this got started in the first place.
: In the beginning, all we were doing was just...hiding our pain inside one another. And we worked because that worked. But if it’s not working anymore...
: If chasing after him is only going to hurt me when it’s supposed to be making me feel better...what the fuck am I doing, Ami?
: Can I let you in on a little secret, Maya?
: Please don’t tell me who else he’s fucking. I really don’t want to know.
: I was just going to say that I’m worried about this Niki thing too.
: Bullshit. There’s no way Sensei would have let her move in without you signing off on it. All you’re doing right now is pitying me.
: No, I’m telling you the truth. Scout’s honor.
: Then how the fuck were you acting so composed around her earlier?
: I’m not sure if I’ve ever been “composed” a second in my life.
: Well, at least you’re aware of it. But still. The way she spoke to you alone made it feel like you two were mother and daughter. So much so that I was convinced it was just a nightmare at first.
: It really feels that way sometimes, doesn’t it? Like the universe is playing pranks on us...making things harder than they have to be just so somebody looking down on us can have a little fun.
: Bad news is there’s no one looking down on us ever.
: You don’t know that for sure, Maya. No one does. So it all comes down to faith. Which is why I ask you this-
: Do you have faith in Sensei?
: Do you think he’ll find his way back to you?
: I’m not really...
: Or do you want to drag him back?
: D...Drag him?...
: That’s right...
: If you’re tired of chasing after him, all you really need to do is keep him on a leash. That way, he won’t ever get too far away.
: Wouldn’t that be the answer to all of your problems?...
: Or perhaps there’s another answer? One even closer...
: All this time, the three of us could have been having fun together...but you always made me wait outside.
: W...What?
: I remember the first time...I didn’t really understand what I was hearing. So I stood there with my ear up against the door for what seemed like an eternity, just...listening.
: You sounded so happy...I’d never heard you make noises like that before. It was almost...intoxicating. And I don’t even like girls. Or at least I didn’t think I did. But with you...
: I don’t know...
: You...
: You...listened to us?...
: Mhm...But that’s not all I did.
: What the fuck?...
: Do you have any idea what it feels like to listen to your best friend and your father fuck each other’s brains out every week for years?
: Because it’s annoying at first. But you start to look forward to it after a while. And you tell yourself every time, soon. Soon, they’ll remember me. Soon, they’ll let me in. Just for a peek.
: And when that day never comes, you get frustrated. You start pretending you’re in there with them. You time your fingers with the creaking of the bed. Time your orgasm with theirs.
: You and I have cum together so many times and you didn’t even know it...
: Isn’t that romantic, Maya?
: Is this...
: Another nightmare?...
: Is this...really happening?...
: That all depends on whether or not you want it to...
: What’s gonna happen if Sensei really does leave you for Niki? How are you going to make yourself feel whole then?
: Because I can still listen...but you’ll be all alone.
: Maybe you can still come over...and we can both play pretend.
: I’m a good actor, Maya. I can play a very convincing Sensei if I have to.
: We could do that other thing I mentioned.
: We could drag him back...
: But here’s the catch...
: If that’s the route you want to take...It will never be only you again.
: Not for the rest of our lives.
: It’ll be all three of us...
: Because how could anyone ever say no to that?
: Ami...
: Maya...
: I’m in.
